title: Tree circuit compilation
statement: Given a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables and an existing list of gates, compile the tree by processing its children in order. A positive literal returns its variable index and leaves the gate list unchanged; a negative literal appends a NOT gate reading that variable and returns the index $n$ plus the resulting gate-list length. At a node, append an AND or OR gate according to its Boolean label, reading the deduplicated list of compiled child outputs, and return $n$ plus the final gate-list length as the output index.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ of input variables
A Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables
